# Vib Apps Engine — Compact AI Agent Specification (`schemaVersion: 1`)

> Canonical Frozen Schema: https://apps.vib.tools/schemas/vibtools-app.schema.json
> Complete A–Z Human & Dev Guide: https://apps.vib.tools/vib-apps-engine/vibtools-app-config.md
> AI Execution Playbook & Prompt: https://apps.vib.tools/vib-apps-engine/ai-guide.md
> Storefront: https://apps.vib.tools | Edge CLI & Download Router: https://get.vib.tools

## 1. Mission & Zero-Touch Auto-Collection Model
When a developer adds a GitHub repository URL to `registry.json` inside `vib-apps-hub` (e.g. `"https://github.com/owner/repo"`), the edge worker automatically:
1. Parses `owner/repo` (and optional `/tree/<branch>`, default `"main"`).
2. Fetches `.vibtools/apps/app.config.json` from that repo via GitHub Contents API (cached 300s at Cloudflare Edge; 404 fallback: `.vibtools/app.config.json`).
3. Validates the JSON strictly against Frozen Schema `v1` (`schemaVersion: 1`, `additionalProperties: false`).
4. Auto-discovers the app `slug`, catalog metadata, version list, and Markdown tabs (`features.md`, `changelog.md`).
5. Routes `https://get.vib.tools/<slug>[/<version>]` to the version's installer script (per-version override or root default) with `$APP_SLUG`, `$APP_VERSION`, and `$APP_NAME` prepended, and routes `https://get.vib.tools/dl/<slug>[/<version>]` via 302 redirect to the version's verified HTTPS binary URL.

## 2. Target Repository Directory Layout
Create the following self-contained folder at the root of the application repository:
```text
<app-repo-root>/
└── .vibtools/
    └── apps/
        ├── app.config.json    # REQUIRED — Frozen v1 manifest
        ├── installer.ps1      # Default PowerShell installer (omit if using remote HTTPS installer URL)
        ├── features.md        # Markdown rendered in "Features & Overview" tab
        └── changelog.md       # Markdown rendered in "Release Changelog" tab
```

## 3. Strict Frozen Schema Contract (`schemaVersion: 1`)
HARD INVARIANTS (violating any rule causes HTTP 422 rejection and hides the app from the catalog):
- MUST NOT invent custom keys on root or inside `versions.<ver>` (`additionalProperties: false`).
- MUST include `"$schema": "https://apps.vib.tools/schemas/vibtools-app.schema.json"` and `"schemaVersion": 1`.
- MUST include required root keys: `"slug"`, `"name"`, `"latest"`, `"versions"`.
- `"slug"` MUST be lowercase `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-_]{0,63}$`.
- `"name"` MUST be 1–80 chars; `"tagline"` (optional) max 160 chars; `"category"` (optional) max 48 chars.
- `"access"` (optional) MUST be `"Free"` or `"Paid"`.
- `"latest"` MUST match an EXACT key inside `"versions"` (e.g. `"v1.0.3"` === `"v1.0.3"`).
- Every key inside `"versions"` MUST match `^[vV]?[0-9][0-9A-Za-z._+-]{0,47}$` (must begin with a digit after optional `v`).
- Every version object MUST include `"url"` starting with `https://` on a trusted host:
  - Default trusted binary hosts: `dl.vib.tools`, `github.com`, `objects.githubusercontent.com`, `release-assets.githubusercontent.com` (plus `env.ALLOWED_DOWNLOAD_HOSTS`).
  - Default trusted remote installer hosts: all above + `raw.githubusercontent.com`.
- Every `"released_at"` MUST be a real calendar ISO date `"YYYY-MM-DD"` (e.g. `"2026-02-31"` is rejected; NEVER use `"releaseDate"`).
- Every `"sha256"` MUST be an exact 64-character hexadecimal string (`^[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$`).
- `"channel"` (optional) MUST be `"stable"`, `"beta"`, or `"alpha"`. `"deprecated"` (optional) MUST be boolean.
- `"icon"`, `"screenshots"`, and `"links"` values MUST start with `https://`.
- `"platforms"` and `"architectures"` (optional) MUST contain unique non-empty strings.
- `"installer"` (root or per-version) and `"docs"` paths MUST NOT contain `..` traversal segments or non-`https://` URI schemes.

### Allowed Root Keys (Exact Frozen List)
`$schema`, `schemaVersion`, `slug`, `name`, `tagline`, `category`, `access`, `icon`, `latest`, `installer`, `docs`, `platforms`, `architectures`, `requirements`, `screenshots`, `links`, `versions`

### Allowed Version Keys (Exact Frozen List)
`url`, `installer`, `size`, `sha256`, `released_at`, `channel`, `deprecated`

## 4. Per-Version Installer Inheritance & Override Rules
Resolution order when a user runs `irm "https://get.vib.tools/<slug>[/<version>]" | iex`:
1. `versions[targetVersion].installer` (if present — string path, trusted `https://` URL, or `{ "type": "powershell", "script": "..." }`).
2. Root `installer` (string path, trusted `https://` URL, or `{ "type": "powershell", "script": "..." }`).
3. Repo defaults: `.vibtools/apps/installer.ps1` -> `.vibtools/installer.ps1` -> `.vibtools/install.ps1`.

Before streaming the script, `get.vib.tools` prepends three sanitized PowerShell variables:
```powershell
$APP_SLUG = "calgrid"
$APP_VERSION = "v1.0.3"
$APP_NAME = "CalGrid"
```

## 5. Canonical Production Template (`.vibtools/apps/app.config.json`)
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://apps.vib.tools/schemas/vibtools-app.schema.json",
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "slug": "calgrid",
  "name": "CalGrid",
  "tagline": "Minimalist desktop calendar widget and event scheduler",
  "category": "Productivity",
  "access": "Free",
  "icon": "https://dl.vib.tools/calgrid/icon.png",
  "latest": "v1.0.3",
  "installer": {
    "type": "powershell",
    "script": ".vibtools/apps/installer.ps1"
  },
  "docs": {
    "features": ".vibtools/apps/features.md",
    "changelog": ".vibtools/apps/changelog.md"
  },
  "platforms": ["Windows 10/11"],
  "architectures": ["x64"],
  "requirements": ["Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)", "PowerShell 5.1+"],
  "links": {
    "docs": "https://docs.vib.tools/calgrid"
  },
  "versions": {
    "v1.0.3": {
      "url": "https://dl.vib.tools/calgrid/v1.0.3/CalGrid-Setup-1.0.3.exe",
      "size": "42.8 MB",
      "sha256": "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855",
      "released_at": "2026-11-15",
      "channel": "stable"
    },
    "v1.0.2": {
      "url": "https://dl.vib.tools/calgrid/v1.0.2/CalGrid-Setup-1.0.2.exe",
      "installer": "https://dl.vib.tools/calgrid/v1.0.2/install.ps1",
      "size": "41.5 MB",
      "sha256": "9f83c605d4c82c3dd9e3b909c29fca53ca74c70284c717ec010746ff79c57c4c",
      "released_at": "2026-10-28",
      "deprecated": true
    }
  }
}
```

## 6. Canonical PowerShell Installer Template (`.vibtools/apps/installer.ps1`)
```powershell
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
if (-not $APP_SLUG) { $APP_SLUG = "calgrid" }
if (-not $APP_VERSION) { $APP_VERSION = "v1.0.3" }
if (-not $APP_NAME) { $APP_NAME = "CalGrid" }

$DownloadUrl = "https://get.vib.tools/dl/$APP_SLUG/$APP_VERSION"
$TempFile = Join-Path $env:TEMP "$APP_SLUG-$APP_VERSION-setup.exe"

Write-Host "==> Downloading $APP_NAME ($APP_VERSION)..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
try {
    Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $DownloadUrl -OutFile $TempFile -UseBasicParsing
    Write-Host "==> Launching installer..." -ForegroundColor Green
    Start-Process -FilePath $TempFile -Wait
} finally {
    if (Test-Path $TempFile) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TempFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
}
Write-Host "==> $APP_NAME ($APP_VERSION) installed." -ForegroundColor Green
```

## 7. Registering the Repo in `vib-apps-hub` (`registry.json`)
Paste only the GitHub repository URL into `registry.json`:
```json
[
  "https://github.com/owner/repo"
]
```
Optional object form (only needed for non-`main` branch or `featured: true`):
```json
[
  {
    "repo": "https://github.com/owner/repo",
    "branch": "main",
    "featured": true
  }
]
```

## 8. Mandatory 12-Point AI Self-Verification Checklist
Before concluding, verify every item:
1. `.vibtools/apps/app.config.json` is valid UTF-8 JSON (no comments, no trailing commas).
2. `"$schema"` is `"https://apps.vib.tools/schemas/vibtools-app.schema.json"` and `"schemaVersion"` is `1`.
3. Every root key is in the exact allowed list (zero extra/custom keys).
4. `"slug"` is strictly lowercase matching `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-_]{0,63}$`.
5. `"latest"` matches an EXACT key in `"versions"`.
6. Every key in `"versions"` starts with a digit after optional `v` (e.g. `v1.0.0`, `1.0.0`).
7. Every version object contains ONLY allowed keys and has a trusted `https://` `"url"`.
8. Every `"released_at"` is strict `"YYYY-MM-DD"` (never `releaseDate`).
9. Every `"sha256"` (if present) is an exact 64-character hex string.
10. Every `"installer"` (root or per-version) points to an existing repo file or trusted `https://` URL.
11. `.vibtools/apps/installer.ps1` uses `$APP_SLUG`, `$APP_VERSION`, and `$APP_NAME` without hardcoding stale versions.
12. `.vibtools/apps/features.md` and `.vibtools/apps/changelog.md` exist, use clean Markdown headings, and contain zero unsafe raw HTML.
